title: —Byron, of course, answered Stephen.
html_source:
Lord Byron, a Romanticist poet of England.

Recall Stephen’s earlier reliance on Byron’s work, (also in chapter 2)

He knew it was right to begin so for he had seen similar titles in the collected poems of Lord Byron.

Here is one of his most famous (and shorter) works.

anchor.prefix:
nly a rhymester!

 —O, get out! said Heron. Everyone knows that Tennyson is the greatest poet.

 —And who do you think is the greatest poet? asked Boland, nudging his neighbour.
anchor.suffix:
Heron gave the lead and all three joined in a scornful laugh.

 —What are you laughing at? asked Stephen.
